test_navigate_to_events.title: Verify clicking Events nav link loads the events page

steps.action: Click the Events link in the sidebar navigation
steps.expected: The Events page starts loading

steps.action: Verify events container is visible
steps.expected: The event feed container renders without errors

test_select_site.title: Verify site dropdown opens and a site can be selected

steps.action: Navigate to Events page and wait for load
steps.expected: Events page loads and the loader disappears

steps.action: Open the site dropdown and select the test site
steps.expected: The dropdown lists sites; selecting one closes the list

steps.action: Verify the selected site name is visible on the page
steps.expected: The chosen site name shows in the site selector

test_select_camera.title: Verify camera dropdown opens and lists cameras

steps.action: Navigate to Events and select the test site
steps.expected: Events page loads with the site applied

steps.action: Open the Locations & Cameras dropdown
steps.expected: A popover opens with the site tree

steps.action: Expand the site node, then All Cameras
steps.expected: Individual camera entries are listed with thumbnails

steps.action: Dismiss the camera menu
steps.expected: The popover closes and the search button is visible again

test_select_duration.title: Verify duration filter can be changed from default

steps.action: Navigate to Events and select the test site
steps.expected: Duration dropdown becomes enabled after site selection

steps.action: Open the duration dropdown and select Last 7 Days
steps.expected: The option list closes after selection

steps.action: Verify the selected duration is shown
steps.expected: The duration selector displays Last 7 Days

test_select_rule.title: Verify rule type filter opens and a rule can be selected

steps.action: Navigate to Events and open the rule type dropdown
steps.expected: The rule type option list opens

steps.action: Select Intrusion Detection
steps.expected: The list closes and the selection applies

steps.action: Verify the rule combobox shows the selected rule
steps.expected: The combobox text contains Intrusion Detection

test_search_events.title: Verify search returns event results after selecting filters

steps.action: Navigate to Events, select the test site and Last 7 Days
steps.expected: Filters are applied and search is available

steps.action: Click the search button and wait for results
steps.expected: The loader runs and event thumbnails appear

steps.action: Verify at least one event result is returned
steps.expected: The result grid shows one or more event thumbnails

test_event_snapshots_valid.title: Verify event thumbnails have real images, not placeholders

steps.action: Run an events search for the test site over Last 7 Days
steps.expected: Event thumbnails appear in the result grid

steps.action: Inspect the first thumbnails' image sources
steps.expected: Thumbnails are real images (blob or data URIs), not the No Image Available placeholder

test_pin_event.title: Verify pinning an event updates the pinned clips counter

steps.action: Run an events search for the test site over Last 7 Days
steps.expected: Event thumbnails appear in the result grid

steps.action: Hover the first event card and click its pin icon
steps.expected: The pin icon appears on hover and accepts the click

steps.action: Verify the pinned clips counter
steps.expected: The counter shows 1 pinned clip

test_review_pinned_clips_button.title: Verify 'Review Pinned Clips' button appears after pinning

steps.action: Run an events search for the test site over Last 7 Days
steps.expected: Event thumbnails appear in the result grid

steps.action: Pin the first event
steps.expected: The pinned clips counter updates

steps.action: Verify the Review Pinned Clips button
steps.expected: The button is visible once at least one clip is pinned

test_search_with_specific_camera.title: Verify search filters results by a single camera channel

steps.action: Run an unfiltered events search and capture the API responses
steps.expected: The response stream reveals a channel that has events

steps.action: Reload Events, reapply the site and duration filters
steps.expected: A fresh search view is ready so the next search dispatches

steps.action: Search again with the request intercepted to that single channel
steps.expected: The search request carries only the discovered channel

steps.action: Verify the API result stream for the filtered search
steps.expected: Events are returned and every event belongs to the requested channel
